newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to hold silver tender for Olympic coins.
newsitem.headline: Japan to hold silver tender for Olympic coins.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry said on Monday it will conduct a tender on January 24 to buy 70 tonnes of silver for coins to be issued for the 1998 Nagano Olympic Games.
The results of the tender will be made available on January 27.
The Finance Ministry earlier said that it would issue five million commemorative silver coins and 55,000 gold coins.
One bullion house official said a rise in silver imports in November was partly attributable to the needs for the tender.
Japan's silver imports in November rose 35.6 percent from a year earlier to 91.09 tonnes, according to Finance Ministry data.
